Thus connection, SQL and ordinary extension use work. This blocks the documented geospatial migration rather than exposing a CLI request or JSON-decoding error. [Render's PostgreSQL13+ contract](https://render.com/docs/postgresql-extensions) lists PostGIS and on-demand CREATE EXTENSION. [PostGIS's distance contract](https://postgis.net/docs/ST_Distance.html) defines the intended geography query; its success is a future acceptance gate, not a current observation.
